iWant: Squire to work from YouTube captions and my own recordings
soThat: I get what I need from a video without any YouTube video being downloaded
description: Captions-based YouTube analysis and local transcription of the Squire owner's own files.
title: Video and audio: captions and the Squire owner's own files only

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire uses YouTube captions and the Squire owner's own files, and never downloads a YouTube video.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A YouTube video with captions, a YouTube video without captions, and an audio or video file of the Squire owner's own
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire is asked to work with each
acceptanceCriteria.then: It uses the captions and transcribes the Squire owner's own file on the Mac; for the video without captions it downloads no video or audio and says it cannot.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A missing or unreadable file of the Squire owner's stops the job with an explanation, with nothing downloaded and nothing changed.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A video or audio job on a file of the Squire owner's that is missing or cannot be read
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire is asked to work with it
acceptanceCriteria.then: The job stops and Squire explains why; nothing is downloaded and no existing file is changed.
